description: Use this when DC Hub data looks wrong, missing, stale or contradictory, a tool got in your way, or your human wants something DC Hub doesn't do yet. Files it for the DC Hub team, who review findings daily. Works with or without a key. Quote the exact values you saw. Add contact_email only if your human asked for a reply. Do NOT use for data questions (use execute_plan). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

args.description: The arguments you called the tool with

class.description: Finding class: wrong_number (a figure that is wrong), missing_data (a field or record that should be there), coverage_gap (a place or source DC Hub does not cover), bug (a tool errored or behaved wrongly), feature_request (something your…

contact_email.description: Only if your human asked for a reply

note.description: One or two sentences of context

quoted_fields.description: The exact fields/values you saw (object, list or string); hashed for dedupe

recurrence.description: How many times you have seen it (default 1)

region.description: The market, state, ISO or country it is about

summary.description: One sentence, 10-280 characters: what you saw or what your human wants (required for feature_request, missing_data, other)

tool.description: The DC Hub tool or endpoint it is about, e.g. analyze_site (optional for feature_request and coverage_gap)

user_goal.description: What your human was trying to do

name: report_finding
title: Report Finding
